_agent_reading_guide.purpose: Canonical schema reference for FanPulse football data - READ THIS BEFORE ANY QUERY
core_rules: Before any query, filter, or calculation, read this schema to understand data structure and availability
results.csv covers ALL international matches (1872-2026, ~49,000 matches) - use for historical analysis
tactical_data.csv covers matches with detailed tactical statistics from WhoScored - use for in-depth tactical analysis
Check match_id prefix to determine data availability and tournament type
Use query_csv tool for custom queries outside the 4 specialized tools
Never fabricate data - if tactical stats unavailable, acknowledge limitation clearly

decision_tree.tactical_details: Use tactical_data.csv (check if match exists first)
decision_tree.custom_query: Use query_csv tool with appropriate table

results.csv.table_role: Primary source for all historical match results and team performance analysis

coverage.match_types: ALL competitions (World Cups, Euros, Copa América, friendlies, qualifiers, etc.)

match_id_prefixes.purpose: Match IDs use prefixes to identify the competition type. Understanding these prefixes is crucial for filtering and analyzing specific tournaments.
format_rules: PREFIX: Competition identifier (e.g., WC, EURO, COPA) followed by underscore
TEAMS: UPPERCASE with underscores replacing spaces (e.g., SOUTH_KOREA, UNITED_STATES)

usage_guide.filter_world_cup: Use match_id LIKE 'WC_%' to get all World Cup matches
usage_guide.filter_friendlies: Use match_id LIKE 'FRIENDLY_%' to get all friendly matches
usage_guide.filter_specific_year: Use match_id LIKE 'WC_2026%' to get World Cup 2026 matches
usage_guide.identify_competition: Extract prefix from match_id to determine competition type

OTHER_.desc: World Cup qualifiers and other competitions

AFCONQ_.desc: Africa Cup of Nations qualification matches

AFCON_.desc: Africa Cup of Nations tournament matches

date.use_for: Time-based filtering, recent form calculation, historical trends

home_score.use_for: Goal statistics, win/loss determination, scoring trends

away_score.use_for: Goal statistics, win/loss determination, scoring trends

country.use_for: Home advantage analysis, tournament host patterns

limitations: NO tactical details (possession, shots, passes, formations)

query_examples.head_to_head: Filter by (home_team='A' AND away_team='B') OR (home_team='B' AND away_team='A')

tactical_data.csv.grain: One row per match with detailed tactical statistics from WhoScored
tactical_data.csv.table_role: Primary source for in-depth tactical analysis with 41 metrics per match

coverage.time_range: 2026-onwards (expandable to any match with WhoScored data)
coverage.match_types: Any competition where WhoScored data is available

match_id.desc: Unique match identifier combining tournament, date, and teams
match_id.use_for: Match lookup, joining with results.csv, tournament filtering

home_formation.use_for: Tactical system analysis, formation matchup studies

away_formation.use_for: Tactical system analysis, formation matchup studies

home_avg_age.desc: Average age of home team's starting XI
home_avg_age.use_for: Team experience analysis, age-based performance correlation

away_avg_age.desc: Average age of away team's starting XI
away_avg_age.use_for: Team experience analysis, age-based performance correlation

home_possession.desc: Average possession percentage for home team across all match minutes
home_possession.use_for: Ball control analysis, possession-based playing style identification

away_possession.desc: Average possession percentage for away team across all match minutes
away_possession.use_for: Ball control analysis, possession-based playing style identification

home_shots_total.desc: Total shots attempted by home team (on target + off target + blocked)
home_shots_total.calculation: Sum of all shot attempts from minute-by-minute data
home_shots_total.use_for: Attacking volume analysis, shot frequency comparison

away_shots_total.desc: Total shots attempted by away team (on target + off target + blocked)
away_shots_total.calculation: Sum of all shot attempts from minute-by-minute data
away_shots_total.use_for: Attacking volume analysis, shot frequency comparison

home_shots_on_target.desc: Shots on target by home team (shots that would score without goalkeeper intervention)
home_shots_on_target.calculation: Sum of on-target shots from minute-by-minute data
home_shots_on_target.use_for: Shot quality analysis, finishing accuracy assessment

away_shots_on_target.desc: Shots on target by away team (shots that would score without goalkeeper intervention)
away_shots_on_target.calculation: Sum of on-target shots from minute-by-minute data
away_shots_on_target.use_for: Shot quality analysis, finishing accuracy assessment

home_shots_blocked.desc: Shots blocked by opposition defenders before reaching goalkeeper
home_shots_blocked.calculation: Sum of blocked shots from minute-by-minute data

away_shots_blocked.desc: Shots blocked by opposition defenders before reaching goalkeeper
away_shots_blocked.calculation: Sum of blocked shots from minute-by-minute data

home_shot_accuracy.desc: Percentage of shots that were on target
home_shot_accuracy.use_for: Finishing quality, shot precision analysis, attacking efficiency

away_shot_accuracy.desc: Percentage of shots that were on target
away_shot_accuracy.use_for: Finishing quality, shot precision analysis, attacking efficiency

home_passes_total.desc: Total passes attempted by home team (successful + unsuccessful)
home_passes_total.calculation: Sum of all pass attempts from minute-by-minute data
home_passes_total.use_for: Passing volume analysis, possession style identification

away_passes_total.desc: Total passes attempted by away team (successful + unsuccessful)
away_passes_total.calculation: Sum of all pass attempts from minute-by-minute data
away_passes_total.use_for: Passing volume analysis, possession style identification

home_pass_accuracy.desc: Percentage of passes that were completed successfully
home_pass_accuracy.use_for: Passing quality, ball retention, technical ability assessment

away_pass_accuracy.desc: Percentage of passes that were completed successfully
away_pass_accuracy.use_for: Passing quality, ball retention, technical ability assessment

home_key_passes.desc: Passes that directly lead to a shot attempt (assists + shot-creating passes)
home_key_passes.calculation: Sum of key passes from minute-by-minute data
home_key_passes.use_for: Chance creation analysis, attacking creativity assessment

away_key_passes.desc: Passes that directly lead to a shot attempt (assists + shot-creating passes)
away_key_passes.calculation: Sum of key passes from minute-by-minute data
away_key_passes.use_for: Chance creation analysis, attacking creativity assessment

home_tackles_won.desc: Successful tackles by home team (regained possession)
home_tackles_won.calculation: Sum of successful tackles from minute-by-minute data
home_tackles_won.use_for: Defensive activity, ball-winning ability, pressing effectiveness

away_tackles_won.desc: Successful tackles by away team (regained possession)
away_tackles_won.calculation: Sum of successful tackles from minute-by-minute data
away_tackles_won.use_for: Defensive activity, ball-winning ability, pressing effectiveness

home_tackle_success.desc: Percentage of tackles that were successful

away_tackle_success.desc: Percentage of tackles that were successful

home_interceptions.desc: Passes intercepted by home team (reading the game, positioning)
home_interceptions.calculation: Sum of interceptions from minute-by-minute data

away_interceptions.desc: Passes intercepted by away team (reading the game, positioning)
away_interceptions.calculation: Sum of interceptions from minute-by-minute data

home_clearances.desc: Defensive clearances by home team (removing danger)
home_clearances.calculation: Sum of clearances from minute-by-minute data

away_clearances.desc: Defensive clearances by away team (removing danger)
away_clearances.calculation: Sum of clearances from minute-by-minute data

home_aerials_won.desc: Aerial duels won by home team
home_aerials_won.calculation: Sum of aerial duels won from minute-by-minute data
home_aerials_won.use_for: Physical dominance, set-piece effectiveness, long-ball strategy

away_aerials_won.desc: Aerial duels won by away team
away_aerials_won.calculation: Sum of aerial duels won from minute-by-minute data
away_aerials_won.use_for: Physical dominance, set-piece effectiveness, long-ball strategy

home_attacking_intensity.use_for: Overall attacking pressure, offensive output measurement
home_attacking_intensity.interpretation: Higher values indicate more attacking threat and chance creation

away_attacking_intensity.use_for: Overall attacking pressure, offensive output measurement
away_attacking_intensity.interpretation: Higher values indicate more attacking threat and chance creation

home_defensive_intensity.use_for: Overall defensive workload, defensive pressure measurement
home_defensive_intensity.interpretation: Higher values indicate more defensive activity (could mean under pressure or aggressive defending)

away_defensive_intensity.use_for: Overall defensive workload, defensive pressure measurement
away_defensive_intensity.interpretation: Higher values indicate more defensive activity (could mean under pressure or aggressive defending)

shot_accuracy.purpose: Measures finishing quality and shot precision

interpretation.high: >40% - Excellent finishing, clinical in front of goal

pass_accuracy.purpose: Measures passing quality and ball retention

interpretation.low: <75% - Risky passing, direct style or under pressure

attacking_intensity.purpose: Measures overall attacking threat and chance creation

defensive_intensity.purpose: Measures overall defensive workload and activity

interpretation.high: >50 - Heavy defensive work (under pressure or aggressive pressing)

use_cases: Shot quality and finishing efficiency assessment
Passing patterns and ball retention analysis
Playing style identification (possession vs direct, attacking vs defensive)
limitations: Limited historical coverage (only matches manually added via scraper)
Requires WhoScored data availability for each match
NO referee, venue, or attendance information
NO corner kicks, fouls, or card statistics

query_examples.formation_analysis: Filter by home_formation='4-3-3' to analyze 4-3-3 performance
query_examples.defensive_workload: Filter by home_defensive_intensity > 50 to find teams under pressure
query_examples.attacking_teams: Filter by home_attacking_intensity > 30 for high-attacking matches
query_examples.world_cup_2026: Filter by match_id LIKE 'WC_2026%' for World Cup 2026 matches

data_quality.accuracy: High - minute-by-minute data aggregated from official match statistics
data_quality.completeness: All 41 metrics available for every match in the dataset
data_quality.update_method: Manual scraping via Playwright automation script

mistake_1.wrong: Assuming tactical_data.csv has all matches from results.csv
mistake_1.right: tactical_data.csv only contains manually scraped matches - check if match exists first

mistake_2.wrong: Using results.csv for tactical details like possession or formations
mistake_2.right: results.csv has NO tactical columns - use tactical_data.csv for tactical analysis

mistake_3.wrong: Fabricating tactical statistics when match not in tactical_data.csv
mistake_3.right: Acknowledge limitation: 'Tactical statistics not available for this match'

mistake_4.wrong: Confusing calculated metrics (shot_accuracy, attacking_intensity) with raw data
mistake_4.right: Understand which metrics are calculated and their formulas for proper interpretation

do: Always check if match exists in tactical_data.csv before claiming tactical data availability
Use results.csv for historical analysis and broad match coverage
Use tactical_data.csv for in-depth tactical analysis when available
Understand calculated metrics formulas for accurate interpretation
Cite data sources clearly (results.csv vs tactical_data.csv)
Consider both raw metrics and calculated metrics for comprehensive analysis
Use match_id to join results.csv and tactical_data.csv when needed
dont: Don't assume all matches have tactical data
Don't confuse possession percentage with possession minutes
Don't ignore calculated metrics - they provide valuable insights
Don't use results.csv for tactical queries
